one_sentence_story: A ten-minute warm shower ninety minutes before bed opens blood vessels in your hands and feet so your core temperature drops fast enough to unlock deep sleep.
so_what_for_you: Don't hop straight from a hot shower under heavy covers. Finish a warm bath or shower 60 to 120 minutes before bed so your body can radiate the heat away.

jargon_map.plain: Warming your skin with a bath or shower instead of exercise.
jargon_map.analogy: Coaxing a thermostat to click on the air-conditioning by warming its sensor.

jargon_map.plain: Warm hands and feet releasing heat faster than your chest.
jargon_map.analogy: Opening the radiator grille on the front of a warm engine.

jargon_map.plain: Your brain's master thermostat and sleep-onset switch.
jargon_map.analogy: A night watchman who dims the building lights the moment core heat drops.
